question: Within a bounded v1.3 static read set, does wonder item 209, Shakespeare's Theatre, reach an exact city-culture read or write, completion consumer, display consumer, or AI consumer?

scope.boundary: This packet tests exact references and split-address materialization for the Shakespeare record, description, and cost cell, then scans decoded literal or comparison uses of item 209 and decompiles the sole emitted function. It does not expand the truncated body, inspect its callers or callees, search the complete culture system or every wonder consumer, reconstruct display, or claim executable-wide absence.

dependencies.use: Provides exact item 209 identity, record, initialized description, and signed cost factor.
Provides the ordinary BuildingWonderProductionCostLookup path excluded from effect evidence.

acceptedAnchors.qualification: The initialized English description is a discovery hint, not proof of city-culture execution.

referenceScan.qualification: Zero reference-manager results do not prove absence from undecoded, indexed, or split-constant paths.

splitAddressScan.negative: No decoded split construction matched the exact Shakespeare record, description, or cost cell.

itemIdScan.result: The complete filtered decoded-instruction scan emitted one literal 0xD1 use.

candidateResults.result: The recovered prefix performs low-level bitfield tests, table reads, and helper dispatch and exposes no Shakespeare, city, culture, completion, display, or AI carrier.
candidateResults.stop: The exact body truncates on bad instruction data, so caller and callee expansion is forbidden.

ordinaryCostBoundary.result: The accepted item-209 cost path remains ordinary wonder production-cost evidence and is not effect consumption.
ordinaryCostBoundary.qualification: Cost selection alone cannot prove city culture, completion, display, or AI behavior.

boundedNegative.result: The completed bounded read set does not establish an exact Shakespeare-to-city-culture, completion, display, or AI edge.
boundedNegative.limits: This negative covers three exact reference targets, the same three split-address targets, the complete one-function filtered scalar result, and the recovered prefix of 0x826CFDC8. It does not classify the truncated suffix or any indexed, indirect, dynamically dispatched, undecoded, or unsearched function.
boundedNegative.falsificationCondition: A complete exact function or independently bounded dataflow joins item 209 or Shakespeare-record-derived state to city culture, completion, display, or AI consumption.

currentEvidence.method: Four sequential foreground read-only Ghidra queries: exact references, capped split constants, a filtered item-209 scalar-use scan, and one exact candidate decompilation.

entries.result: The record, description, and cost cell have zero reference-manager entries.
No exact target was materialized and the scan did not truncate.
Exactly one filtered literal was emitted and the scan did not truncate.
The recovered prefix has no item-specific culture carrier and the exact body truncates on bad instruction data, activating the packet stop.

currentEvidence.qualification: The Ghidra project and flat image match the accepted v1.3 contract and were queried read-only without a project lock. No generated-code discovery, runtime probe, or indirect-target inference was used.

guards: Do not claim that no Shakespeare consumer exists outside the bounded read set.
Do not infer city-culture behavior from the initialized English description.
Do not treat ordinary cost selection through 0x82CF1278 as completion or effect evidence.
Do not classify or expand the truncated item-209 scalar candidate without a new independent discriminator.
conclusion: The bounded v1.3 static read set did not establish an exact Shakespeare city-culture, completion, display, or AI edge. Exact and split-address scans found no record-derived candidates. The complete filtered item-209 scan yielded one literal use, but its recovered function prefix carries no Shakespeare or culture state and the exact body truncates on bad instruction data. This is not an executable-wide absence claim.
